intent: Keep release ledger and gate output plus redacted blocking or sampled transcripts in Git, and archive raw evaluation runs locally instead of committing every run.
amendments: The maintainer approved the release-evaluation redesign evidence storage policy.

cases.procedure: tests/scripts/eval.test.mjs: raw batch archives stay local while Git exposes ledger and gate files

limitations: Real smoke baselines, candidate batches and confirmation runs are deferred.
Real full-tier bulk runs, compatible baselines and release-model anchors are deferred.
Real judge calibration, blocking-verdict audit and sampled conversation audit are deferred.
Real release archive creation and retention verification are deferred until captures are available.
The storage test uses real fake-host batch artifacts and a synthetic gate file; release-gate tests independently validate gate contents.
Existing tracked historical evidence remains in Git for acceptance references and calibration.
